# Inherited third-party material

`legacy-zones/` preserves all 442 GeoJSON files from the reviewed baseline's `data/zones/`. This collection is not read by country runs or builds. Active SE/FI/NO files live under `data/reference/bidding-zones/` and are selected by release geography configuration.

The original acquisition source, revision and licence were not recorded. Do not infer a redistribution grant from these filenames or a resemblance to a public dataset. Checksums and original paths are in `docs/archive/v1/relocation-manifest.json`. Establish provenance and rights before a new external redistribution.
